name: trivial_2x2
description: Trivial 2x2 SDP: max x_11 s.t. x_11=1, X>=0. Optimal X*=diag(1,0) is SINGULAR (rank-deficient boundary optimum). Tests that the solver handles PSD-boundary cases (CLAUDE.md invariant 1).

known_gaps.reason: at the natural escalation ceiling (target_digits=30 forces escalation to 1024 bits for 14.2 objective digits) the cost is ~72 bits/digit, far above the 8 b/d goal; the b30 PSD-boundary brittleness (NUM at 128/256/512) is the driver.
